what: Toyota is the world's largest carmaker by vehicles sold, with the Toyota and Lexus brands and a leading position in hybrids. It also runs a large car-finance business.
customers: Car buyers worldwide, served through dealers; Japan, North America and Asia are the biggest markets.
moat: A reputation for reliability, the Toyota Production System's cost discipline and a hybrid line-up few rivals can match.
risks: The shift to electric cars and Chinese competition
